title: Part Time Payroll Administrator
description:
Anderson Knight is currently recruiting for an experienced Part-Time Payroll Administrator to join a well-established service business based in Motherwell.

Reporting to the Payroll Manager, you will provide efficient and accurate payroll support across the group, helping to ensure all payrolls are processed correctly and within the required deadlines.

Key duties and responsibilities will include:
- Processing weekly and monthly payrolls from end to end.
- Processing PAYE, NIC and statutory payments, including SMP, SAP, SPP and SSP.
- Maintaining up-to-date knowledge of auto-enrolment and pension requirements.
- Processing new starters, leavers, P45s, P60s, pensions, auto-enrolments, student loans and earnings arrestments.
- Responding to and resolving employee payroll queries.
- Ensuring all payroll deadlines are met.
- Maintaining accurate payroll records and ensuring all information is processed correctly.

The successful candidate will have:
- Previous experience in a payroll administration role.
- Experience processing payrolls from start to finish.
- Good knowledge of PAYE, NIC and statutory payments.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- The ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
- Strong communication, time management and organisational skills.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, including Word, Outlook and Excel.
- A reliable and professional approach to their work.

This is a great opportunity for an experienced Payroll Administrator looking for a part-time position with a well-established and successful business. The role will provide excellent hands-on experience within a supportive team and the opportunity to develop your payroll skills further.

To apply for this Part-Time Payroll Administrator opportunity, please forward your CV in confidence.

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Anderson Knight Recruitment is working with a well-established accountancy practice based in Motherwell to recruit an Accounts Assistant to join their growing team.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to build a long-term career within accountancy, whether you have previous accounts experience or are looking to take the next step from a finance administration role. Working alongside an experienced team, you will gain exposure to a varied portfolio of clients and develop your technical accounting knowledge across a range of day-to-day finance duties.

A key selling point of this opportunity is the potential to progress into a Trainee Accountant position, with the opportunity to begin professional accountancy qualifications and work towards becoming a qualified accountant. This makes it an ideal role for someone who is keen to learn, develop their skills and build a career within an established accountancy practice.

Key Responsibilities:
- Assisting with the preparation and maintenance of financial records for a portfolio of clients
- Processing purchase and sales invoices, bank transactions and journals
- Completing bank reconciliations and assisting with balance sheet reconciliations
- Supporting the preparation and submission of VAT returns in line with Making Tax Digital (MTD) requirements
- Assisting with accounts payable and accounts receivable activities
- Supporting the preparation of management accounts and year-end financial information
- Liaising with clients to obtain relevant financial information and resolve queries
- Using accounting software such as Xero, QuickBooks, Sage or similar systems
- Assisting senior members of the team with bookkeeping and general accounting duties
- Developing an understanding of accounting principles, tax and compliance requirements
- Working towards taking on additional responsibilities as your knowledge and experience grow

Requirements:
- Previous experience in an Accounts Assistant, Finance Assistant or similar role would be advantageous
- An interest in pursuing a long-term career within accountancy
- Basic understanding of bookkeeping, reconciliations and general accounting principles
- Good IT skills, with experience using Excel and accounting software beneficial
- Strong attention to detail and a methodical approach to work
- Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to manage deadlines and competing priorities
- Confident communication skills and the ability to build positive relationships with clients and colleagues
- A proactive attitude, willingness to learn and enthusiasm for professional development
- A genuine interest in studying towards a professional accountancy qualification, such as AAT, ACCA or ICAS

What's On Offer:
- Competitive salary, depending on experience
- Opportunity to progress into a Trainee Accountant position
- Potential to commence professional accountancy qualifications, subject to the firm's study support arrangements
- Practical training and development within an established accountancy practice
- Exposure to a varied portfolio of clients across different sectors
- Support from experienced accountants who can help develop your technical knowledge
- Clear opportunities to build your experience and progress within the business
- Supportive team environment with a focus on long-term development
- Flexible working arrangements, where appropriate

If you are motivated, eager to learn and interested in developing your career within a supportive accountancy practice, please apply via the link below.

title: HR Coordinator
description:
Anderson Knight is delighted to be partnering with a well-established organisation to recruit an HR Coordinator on a 6 month fixed-term contract.

This opportunity would suit an experienced HR Administrator or HR Coordinator looking to gain broader exposure across employee relations, compliance, and operational HR activities. Equally, applications are welcomed from recent HR graduates who have gained administrative experience and are looking to take the next step in their HR career.

Joining a supportive and collaborative HR team, you will play a key role in delivering high-quality HR administration and coordination support, helping to ensure employee records, compliance processes, and HR casework are managed efficiently and accurately.

This is a hybrid position, with three days per week in the office and two days working from home. The role is contracted to 35 hours per week and offers a salary of up to 30,000.

Key Responsibilities
- Provide administrative support across a variety of employee relations matters, including absence management, disciplinary, grievance, capability, performance management, flexible working requests, and organisational change processes.
- Prepare HR correspondence, meeting documentation, casework packs, and outcome letters.
- Act as a first point of contact for HR-related enquiries, responding to requests and escalating more complex matters where appropriate.
- Maintain accurate employee records and HR systems, ensuring information is up to date and compliant.
- Produce and support reporting on HR activity, case volumes, and workforce trends.
- Coordinate Right to Work checks and ensure compliance with relevant legislation and internal processes.
- Monitor compliance activities, including professional registrations, renewals, and regulatory requirements.
- Review Occupational Health and PVG-related invoices, investigating any discrepancies and supporting accurate processing.
- Provide administrative and compliance support to HR Business Partners and line managers.
- Handle confidential and sensitive information with professionalism and discretion at all times.

About You

To be successful in this role, you will ideally have:
- Previous experience in an HR administration or HR coordination position.
- Experience supporting employee relations processes and maintaining HR records.
- A degree in HR, Business, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical HR experience.
- CIPD membership or a desire to work towards a CIPD qualification.
- Excellent organisational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
- Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Confidence using Microsoft 365 applications and HR systems.
- A professional and confidential approach when handling sensitive employee information.

Desirable Experience
- Experience working within a regulated or social care environment.
- Knowledge of Right to Work legislation and workforce compliance requirements.
- Experience administering PVG checks or similar pre-employment screening processes.
- Exposure to Dayforce HRIS or similar HR systems.

What's on Offer
- Hybrid working arrangement (3 days office / 2 days home)
- Salary up to 30,000
- Exposure to a broad range of HR activities and employee relations matters
- Supportive and collaborative HR team environment
- Excellent opportunity to develop and broaden your HR career
